sentences.en: The bronze armor was useless against the Saxons' relentless attack.
sentences.zh: 这青铜盔甲对撒克逊人的无情攻击毫无用处。

sentences.en: In Algeria, the heat of the sun can be relentless in the summer.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔及利亚，夏季的阳光酷热难耐，毫不留情。

sentences.en: Layla's relentless quest of love led her into the arms of a very violent man.
sentences.zh: 莱拉为了爱情不懈追求，最终却走进了一个非常暴力的男人的怀抱。
